overloadMerges.note: The two doc syntax lines differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether object is a name-string vs. a Variable/Field reference); collapsed into one overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator. Also corrected direction on out-parameters (doc arrow column shows them as command outputs, not inputs) which the mechanical parser had defaulted to 'in'.

params.name: asObjectName
params.description: If present, object below is the name of the form object (string); if omitted, object is a variable or field reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Object name (if * is specified) or Variable or field (if * is omitted)

sentinelValues.meaning: The subform uses a project form (not bound to a table).

params.name: detailSubform
params.description: Name of the detail form: the form's name if created in the 4D form editor, its 'name' attribute if created from a .json file or 4D object (falling back to the .json file's name, or "untitled" for an object, if that attribute is undefined).

params.name: listSubform
params.description: Name of the list form (table form), following the same naming fallback rules as detailSubform; returned as an empty string if there is no list form.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: The OBJECT GET SUBFORM command gets the name(s) of the form(s) associated with the subform object designated by the object and * parameters.
